issue.title: test_warm_cache_update_display_does_not_walk_artifacts_on_event_loop asserts a warm cache but sees one discover walk under parallel CI legs
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-um.9.5.3 (note #2) during epic sase-um.9.5 ("Complete the
interrupted sase-um.9 release-gate landing"), routed to a task by sase-um.9.5.land on
2026-08-29. Recorded as a node-specific bead rather than a corroboration because
sase-ct, the retired umbrella for "flaky ACE TUI tests under the full parallel just test
run", forbids +1/reopen and routes exactly this shape of report to a narrow task named
for the failing node ID. No other open or closed task bead names this node.

The assertion that fails is `discover_mock.call_count == 0`: the test proves the warm
artifact cache lets the Tools panel update its display without walking artifacts on the
event loop. When it fails, call_count is 1 -- a real discover walk happened on a warm
cache. That is a stronger signal than a timing wobble, so the triage should establish
whether the warm-cache precondition is being lost under load (another test poisoning
process-global cache state, or a cache warm-up that has not completed when the display
update runs) before treating it as scheduler noise.

task_type_fields.evidence:
Two independent CI failures, one local serial pass:

- Full CI run 33216659649, test(3.12) leg, SHA affc43a6f: FAILED with
  discover_mock.call_count 1, expected 0.
- Full CI run 33167273442, coverage-contexts leg: same node, same assertion.
- Serial rerun on master tip 1a1463028 in the epic's workspace: passed.

Fail/pass shape: red only under a parallel CI leg, green on an isolated serial rerun --
the class sase-ct was retired for. Two legs (plain 3.12 and coverage-contexts) rules out
a single leg's coverage instrumentation as the sole trigger. Do not mute.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just test-scoped -- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_tools_panel_event_loop.py (red only under the full parallel/CI lane)

payload.description: Retired umbrella for the 'flaky ACE TUI test under the full parallel lane' class; its close reason routes this shape of report to a node-specific bead like this one instead of a +1.

In-progress epic fixing the sase-ct flake class at its root. If this node's warm-cache precondition is lost because another test poisons global artifact-cache state, sase-j7.2's leak detector is the instrument.
